who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), writer lane D156 (flow-lower one call rule seam)
what: Switching flow-lower's nine call paths onto blaze_borrow::call met two facts no doc states together: (1) a body's values are types of the checked record's table while a head's columns are laid in `Facts::region_tys()`, a different table in production (the fixtures' WithRegions does not forward it, so fixtures hide the split); the contract's Cx read both from one `types`. (2) The flow's origins are laid by `npos` (an opaque, an alias, a trait object ONE position each, a fn item none) and the contract's by `Columns` slots (an opaque: its captures plus its arguments'; an alias: its trait's and GAT's lifetimes then its arguments'; a dyn: 1 plus its predicates'): the same value has different origin counts under the two models. Also clause columns are laid subject-first `ExTrait(Tr, [T, A..])` while impl headers lay `ExTrait(Tr, [A..])`, without Self.
cost: most of the lane's reading time went to establishing these three from code (no build allowed in a writer lane)
cause: two layouts and two tables grew in separate pieces (D148 heads, D156 contract) with no type separating a record PTy from a head PTy and no shared layout
whys: PTy is one type for every table; npos was the flow's model before slots existed; ExTrait carries no flag saying whether Self is in its list
class: an index valid in one table or one layout read in another: silent on fixtures that use one table, a Shape refusal or a wrong pairing in production
prevention: done here: Cx carries `sig_types` and each side reads its own table (test each_side_is_read_in_its_own_table); the adapter refuses by name (OneRuleWhy::PositionsNotSlots) wherever npos and slots part. Wanted: a typed PTy per table (RecordTy, HeadTy) and the flow laying slots (D156 C3), after which npos is deleted
annoyance: a writer lane cannot grep with a tool other than Bash, and git diff here is difftastic
workaround: read with Read and grep through Bash; never sed over .rs
